mapper.sql: SELECT r.* , CASE WHEN () = 'VALID' AND h.EMPLYR_ID <> r.APPLCNT_ID THEN h.EMPLYR_ID END AS HEAD_APRV_ID FROM ASSET_REQ r LEFT JOIN ASSET_DEPT_HEAD h ON h.ORGNZT_ID = r.ORGNZT_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO e ON e.EMPLYR_ID = h.EMPLYR_ID
EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM COMTNEMPLYRINFO e JOIN COMTNEMPLYRSCRTYESTBS ar ON ar.SCRTY_DTRMN_TRGET_ID = e.ESNTL_ID AND ar.AUTHOR_CODE = 'ROLE_ADMIN' WHERE AND e.EMPLYR_ID <> x.APPLCNT_ID)
mapper.select: SELECT x.REQ_NO, x.APPLCNT_ID, ap.USER_NM AS APPLCNT_NM, x.ORGNZT_ID, o.ORGNZT_NM, x.REQ_RESN, x.STTUS, x.REQ_PNTTM , x.APRV_ID, av.USER_NM AS APRV_NM, x.APRV_PNTTM, x.LAST_PROCESS_ID, x.LAST_PROCESS_PNTTM , (SELECT i.ITEM_NM FROM ASSET_REQ_LINE l JOIN ASSET_ITEM i ON i.ITEM_CODE = l.ITEM_CODE WHERE l.REQ_NO = x.REQ_NO ORDER BY l.ITEM_CODE LIMIT 1) AS FIRST_ITEM_NM , (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSET_REQ_LINE l WHERE l.REQ_NO = x.REQ_NO) AS LINE_CNT , (x.STTUS = 'PENDING' AND x.HEAD_APRV_ID IS NULL AND NOT ) AS NO_APPROVER FROM ( SELECT x.* ORDER BY x.REQ_PNTTM DESC, x.REQ_NO DESC LIMIT #{recordCountPerPage} OFFSET #{firstIndex} ) x LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO ap ON ap.EMPLYR_ID = x.APPLCNT_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO av ON av.EMPLYR_ID = x.APRV_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = x.ORGNZT_ID ORDER BY x.REQ_PNTTM DESC, x.REQ_NO DESC
SELECT e.EMPLYR_ID AS APPLCNT_ID, o.ORGNZT_ID FROM COMTNEMPLYRINFO e LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = e.ORGNZT_ID WHERE e.EMPLYR_ID = #{emplyrId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ASSET_REQ (REQ_NO, APPLCNT_ID, ORGNZT_ID, REQ_RESN, STTUS, REQ_PNTTM, LAST_PROCESS_ID, LAST_PROCESS_PNTTM) VALUES (#{reqNo}, #{applcntId}, #{orgnztId}, #{reqResn}, 'PENDING', SYSDATE(), #{applcntId}, SYSDATE())
INSERT INTO ASSET_REQ_LINE (REQ_NO, ITEM_CODE, REQ_QTY, LINE_STTUS) VALUES (#{reqNo}, #{itemCode}, #{reqQty}, 'PENDING')

INSERT INTO ASSET_REQ_HIST (REQ_HIST_ID, REQ_NO, BEFORE_STTUS, AFTER_STTUS, RESN, PROCESS_ID, PROCESS_PNTTM) VALUES (#{reqHistId}, #{reqNo}, #{beforeSttus}, #{afterSttus}, #{resn}, #{processId}, SYSDATE())
mapper.select: SELECT REQ_NO, APPLCNT_ID, ORGNZT_ID, STTUS FROM ASSET_REQ WHERE REQ_NO = #{reqNo} FOR UPDATE

SELECT l.REQ_NO, l.ITEM_CODE, i.ITEM_NM, i.ITEM_TY, l.REQ_QTY, l.APRV_QTY, l.LINE_STTUS, l.REJECT_RESN FROM ASSET_REQ_LINE l JOIN ASSET_ITEM i ON i.ITEM_CODE = l.ITEM_CODE WHERE l.REQ_NO = #{reqNo} ORDER BY l.ITEM_CODE FOR UPDATE OF l

SELECT r.REQ_NO, r.APPLCNT_ID, ap.USER_NM AS APPLCNT_NM, r.ORGNZT_ID, o.ORGNZT_NM, r.REQ_RESN, r.STTUS, r.REQ_PNTTM , r.APRV_ID, av.USER_NM AS APRV_NM, r.APRV_PNTTM, r.LAST_PROCESS_ID, lp.USER_NM AS LAST_PROCESS_NM, r.LAST_PROCESS_PNTTM FROM ASSET_REQ r LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO ap ON ap.EMPLYR_ID = r.APPLCNT_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO av ON av.EMPLYR_ID = r.APRV_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO lp ON lp.EMPLYR_ID = r.LAST_PROCESS_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = r.ORGNZT_ID WHERE r.REQ_NO = #{reqNo}

SELECT l.REQ_NO, l.ITEM_CODE, i.ITEM_NM, i.ITEM_TY, i.USE_AT, l.REQ_QTY, l.APRV_QTY, l.LINE_STTUS, l.REJECT_RESN FROM ASSET_REQ_LINE l JOIN ASSET_ITEM i ON i.ITEM_CODE = l.ITEM_CODE WHERE l.REQ_NO = #{reqNo} ORDER BY l.ITEM_CODE

SELECT h.REQ_HIST_ID, h.REQ_NO, h.BEFORE_STTUS, h.AFTER_STTUS, h.RESN, h.PROCESS_ID, p.USER_NM AS PROCESS_NM, h.PROCESS_PNTTM FROM ASSET_REQ_HIST h LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO p ON p.EMPLYR_ID = h.PROCESS_ID WHERE h.REQ_NO = #{reqNo} ORDER BY h.REQ_HIST_ID

SELECT r.REQ_NO, r.REQ_PNTTM, r.APPLCNT_ID, ap.USER_NM AS APPLCNT_NM, r.ORGNZT_ID, o.ORGNZT_NM , l.ITEM_CODE, i.ITEM_NM, i.ITEM_TY, i.USE_AT, l.REQ_QTY, l.APRV_QTY, l.LINE_STTUS, l.REJECT_RESN , r.STTUS AS REQ_STTUS, r.APRV_ID, av.USER_NM AS APRV_NM, r.LAST_PROCESS_PNTTM FROM ASSET_REQ r JOIN ASSET_REQ_LINE l ON l.REQ_NO = r.REQ_NO JOIN ASSET_ITEM i ON i.ITEM_CODE = l.ITEM_CODE LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO ap ON ap.EMPLYR_ID = r.APPLCNT_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNEMPLYRINFO av ON av.EMPLYR_ID = r.APRV_ID LEFT JOIN COMTNORGNZTINFO o ON o.ORGNZT_ID = r.ORGNZT_ID WHERE r.REQ_PNTTM >= STR_TO_DATE(#{fromDe}, '%Y-%m-%d') AND r.REQ_PNTTM < DATE_ADD(STR_TO_DATE(#{toDe}, '%Y-%m-%d'), INTERVAL 1 DAY) ORDER BY r.REQ_PNTTM, r.REQ_NO, l.ITEM_CODE
